pairs.subject: quality-gates
pairs.evidence: src/lib/analyze/index.ts:802 The D6 detector awards 15 points labelled 'Quality ratchet / debt ceiling enforced' (index.ts:912) when a file merely has 'ratchet' in its name, so the gated party (a repo, often an improvement-loop agent) can produce the token without the property, and the verdict reads as a ceiling when it is only a floor.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/analyze/index.ts:802 Name key: any core-path file named *ratchet* earns the 'enforced' award on its own (ratchetPath alone satisfies index.ts:912). The author can add the key without the blocking property, and the label claims enforcement.

src/lib/analyze/index.ts:926 The zero-warning award matches raw, lowercased workflow text that still contains comments, so a YAML comment mentioning --max-warnings 0 satisfies it. D4 already does this right by keeping only uses:/run: lines (index.ts:639).
src/lib/analyze/index.ts:810 The detector credits a linter whose warnings fail the build separately from one that is merely configured, which is enforcement by construction rather than by label.
src/lib/analyze/index.ts:805 A measured false positive (game repos) was fixed by narrowing the DEBT_CEILING key. The award was kept, not deleted.

src/lib/analyze/platform-carry.ts:92 Observed, carried and unobservable are derived states, and an unobservable dimension is excluded from the verdict rather than scored as a gap. The CI-health sample floor at platform-signals.ts:170 skips rates below 5 runs.

src/lib/analyze/index.ts:1220 A crashed detector takes its own path: a warning plus failed:true. pulls.ts:525 refuses to blend evidence over it, so an instrument failure never reads as a measured zero.

src/lib/maturity/model.ts:27 The rule 'bump the rubric version when a scoring knob moves' is mechanised by two hash pins instead of living only in prose, and the residue no pin can reach is named (model.ts:34).
src/lib/maturity/model.ts:29 The two pins are an explicit partition: the declaration hash versus the end-to-end pipeline fingerprint. Neither one's green is taken as covering the other's question.

src/lib/analyze/calibration.test.ts:4 The blocking calibration and fingerprint pins read only offline fixtures. The live model answer and network ingestion are explicitly left out of what may go red (model.ts:34).
